scenes.say: Smoking doesn't just hurt your lungs. It hurts your eyes too. Here are three facts most smokers don't know.

scenes.en: Smoke irritates and dries the eye surface.
scenes.say: Number three. Smoke irritates the surface of the eye and dries it out, even for people sitting nearby.

scenes.en: Studies show smokers are more likely to get cataracts.
scenes.say: Number two. Studies show smokers are more likely to get cataracts. That's when the clear lens inside the eye turns cloudy, and vision gets blurry.

scenes.en: Smoking raises the risk of AMD, which damages central vision.
scenes.say: Number one. Smoking raises the risk of age-related macular degeneration. It damages the centre of the retina, the part you use to read and see faces.

scenes.en: Smoke harms tiny blood vessels and stresses eye tissue.
scenes.ta: புகை ரத்தக் குழாய்களையும் கண் திசுக்களையும் பாதிக்கும்
scenes.say: Why? Smoke damages tiny blood vessels, and puts extra stress on the delicate tissues of the eye.

scenes.en: Quitting lowers your risk, at any age.
scenes.say: The good news? Quitting lowers your risk, at any age. Add a daily walk, and eat leafy greens and colourful vegetables.

scenes.en: Check BP and sugar. Yearly eye test after 40.
scenes.say: Keep your blood pressure and sugar in check. And after forty, get your eyes tested every year.

scenes.en: Straight lines look wavy, or a dark spot appears in the centre
scenes.ta: நேர் கோடுகள் வளைந்து தெரிந்தால் உடனே பாருங்கள்
scenes.say: See an eye specialist soon if straight lines look wavy, or a dark spot appears in the middle of your vision. Book an eye test today.
